cd /app && python3 -c "
from slugify import slugify

# Test case 1
result = slugify('value', replacements=[('value', 'one--two')], replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='-', max_length=6)
print(f'Test 1: {repr(result)} (expected: \"one--t\")')

# Test case 2
result2 = slugify('value', replacements=[('value', 'one::::two')], replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='::', max_length=8)
print(f'Test 2: {repr(result2)} (expected: \"one::::t\")')

# Test case 3: max_length=4
result3 = slugify('value', replacements=[('value', 'one--two')], replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='-', max_length=4)
print(f'Test 3 (max_length=4): {repr(result3)} (expected: \"one\")')

# Test case 4: max_length=5
result4 = slugify('value', replacements=[('value', 'one--two')], replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='-', max_length=5)
print(f'Test 4 (max_length=5): {repr(result4)} (expected: \"one\")')

# Test case 5: only separators
result5 = slugify('--one', replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='-', max_length=10)
print(f'Test 5 (--one): {repr(result5)} (expected: \"one\")')

# Test case 6: only dashes
result6 = slugify('---', replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='-', max_length=10)
print(f'Test 6 (---): {repr(result6)} (expected: \"\")')

# Test case 7: cut at 3
result7 = slugify('--one', replacement_stage='post', allow_unicode=True, separator='-', max_length=3)
print(f'Test 7 (--one, max_length=3): {repr(result7)} (expected: \"--o\")')
"
